description: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs: All use-case wrappers (`verify_tls_server`, `verify_tls_client_dns`, `verify_smime_signer`, etc.) now take `V: SignatureVerifier` and `A: AiaFetcher` parameters instead of hardwiring `DefaultVerifier` and `NoAiaFetcher`. This completes the trust-domain seam design: all three callbacks (signature, revocation, AIA) are caller-pluggable at the same level. Breaking change is free pre-1.0 and the updated doc comments accurately describe the new parameters. All test call sites updated consistently.
title: Good: use-case wrappers now fully generic
